name: Marek Sud
bio: Ran a relay mast for eleven years and can tell a lance from a convoy by the shape of the return alone.

personality.label: Patient listener
personality.description: Hears patterns in static. Unhurried and reassuring, with a relay operator’s dislike of chatter.

move: Route received. Keeping the channel open.
guard: Listening from here. I will call what matters.
investigate: There is a pattern in that return. Going to check.
heavy_fire: Heavy impacts on my hull. Requesting cover.
Signal is fine. Armour is not. I need relief.
